DIV8.HEAD: § 16.21 Mandatory label information.
DIV8.P: There shall be stated on the brand label or separate front label, or on a back or side label, separate and apart from all other information, the following statement:

EXTRACT.P: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects.
(2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
